items.title: Coherent growth, relaxation and alternative mechanisms
items.text: The paper argues against a highly disordered shell because WAXS shows crystalline features. Low-coverage coherent epitaxy remains difficult to prove because Cd/Se dominate scattering. The cited12%CdSe/ZnS mismatch motivates both; they are hypotheses, not resolved atomistic pathways.
